subject: storytime
title: Market Street words
about: CJ and his grandma ride the bus across the city on a rainy Sunday, and she helps him see the good in every person and place they pass on the way to the last stop. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the story, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, with him reading the words he practised.

book.author: Matt de la Peña
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A rainy bus ride with a wise grandma who shows a boy how beautiful his city can be.

passage.text:
bus Nana rain city
street market stop soup
man dog coins dirt
trees play last look
there beautiful

cards.note: capital N, it is a name for a grandma; the last a says u: Nan-uh
c says s before i; two parts: cit-y; y at the end says ee: sit-ee
s-t-r blend, then ee says long e
two parts: mar + ket; ar says ar
ou says oo here, like in you: soop
oi says oy, like coin; the s says z
ir says er, like in her
t-r blend; ee says long e; the s says z
p-l blend, then ay says long a
all regular; s-t at the end
oo says oo as in book
eau says yoo and the u says oo as in book: byoo-ti-ful
